name: Tail Gunner
author: Dial0
description: Take on enemy planes and dodge their shots among the clouds in this aerial shooter made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

descriptions.en: Take on enemy planes and dodge their shots among the clouds in this aerial shooter made for the first WASM-4 game jam.
descriptions.it: Affronta gli aerei nemici ed evita i loro colpi tra le nuvole in questo sparatutto aereo creato per la prima game jam di WASM-4.
